pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel-edge gradients. Spatial area is largest on the upper flank/shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more condensed and rounded geometries on the posterior flank and upper leg. A diagonal foreground obstruction (likely a fence wire) causes a linear blur across the anterior-most patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-colored pelage forming tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, though pixel clarity is reduced in the anterior region due to foreground occlusion.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical anatomical indentations on the mid-flank creating localized shadow-casting troughs that cross multiple pelage patches.
